reference_sql:
WITH line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching lines
  SELECT promo_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN promo_id IS NOT NULL THEN n_lines - 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_with_promo,
       SUM(CASE WHEN promo_id IS NULL THEN n_lines - 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_without_promo
FROM line_sets
alternatives:
WITH line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching lines
  SELECT promo_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n_lines - 1) FILTER (WHERE promo_id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS n_with_promo,
       COALESCE(SUM(n_lines - 1) FILTER (WHERE promo_id IS NULL), 0) AS n_without_promo
FROM line_sets

other_way.tradeoff: FILTER says which sets each sum takes, but it needs COALESCE for a sum over no rows, which CASE with ELSE 0 avoids.

solver.query:
WITH sets AS (SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n - 1) FILTER (WHERE promo_id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS n_with_promo,
       COALESCE(SUM(n - 1) FILTER (WHERE promo_id IS NULL), 0) AS n_without_promo
FROM sets
